definitions.gloss: memory (ability); ability to learn and remember things
definitions.explanation: One's capacity to memorize and retain information. Often used with adjectives like good or bad to describe someone's memory skills.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My memory has gotten worse lately.

examples.japanese: {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm a quick learner, so I picked up the job quickly.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (things) + ⟦{覚|おぼ}え→覚え：22843_oboe⟧ (remembering) → the ability to take things in and retain them

COMMON PATTERNS:
The word is almost always the subject of an evaluating adjective, marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧:
- {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ - to have a good memory
- {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - to have a bad memory
- {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ - to be a quick learner
- {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ - to be a slow learner
It is rarely the object of a verb, and it does not take a plural or a count.

USAGE:
{物覚|ものおぼ}え names the practical knack of picking things up — a new job, a set of names, a route — not memories themselves (⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧) and not the mental faculty of memory in the abstract (⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧).

Saying {物覚|ものおぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ of yourself is an ordinary, mildly self-deprecating remark. Said of someone else it is a criticism of their competence, so it is best avoided to their face.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧ - memory capacity; more formal and more clinical, and the word used in test results or medical contexts
- ⟦{暗記力|あんきりょく}→暗記力：30239_ankiryoku⟧ - the ability to memorize by rote, as for an exam; narrower than {物覚|ものおぼ}え
